args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4 is
the lowest fixed version on the 2.x line, so this keeps the major
version pinned at 2.x.

args.body:
## What
Bumps the `fastjson` pin in `requirements.txt` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4`.

## Why
`fastjson` `2.8.0` is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected range is `<2.9.4` on the 2.x line; `2.9.4` is the lowest fixed version, so this stays within the existing `2.x` pin to minimize upgrade risk.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` (branch `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337`): **passed**.

## Notes
- No other dependency versions are touched in this change.
- Kept the exact pin style (`==`) consistent with the rest of the file.
